Codemode

Composition lives on MCP only: search ranks page tools across sessions, execute runs one JS program over them. The CLI has no search or execute — wire the MCP server (see Installation) and call them as tools.

Search

One query across sessions. Name handles to fail loud on an unknown session; omit them to sweep every session best-effort, with misses recorded in skipped.

{ "query": "price", "handles": ["s_abc123"] }
json
{ "query": "price", "tools": [  { "session": "s_abc123", "tool": {}, "score": 12 }], "skipped": [] }
json

Ranking is deterministic and field-weighted: name exact match outranks a name substring, which outranks a description hit, which outranks a schema-text hit. Ties break alphabetically. A dead browser degrades the sweep (browser unreachable in skipped) — it never kills its siblings.

Execute

Real code over session tools via a tools.* proxy. One handle binds tools flat; sessions[] namespaces them for cross-site joins (tools.s1.priceOf, alias with as, else s1…sN).

{ "handle": "s_abc123",  "code": "return await tools.priceOf({sku:'demo-1'});" }
json
{ "sessions": [    { "handle": "s_aaa", "as": "shop" },    { "handle": "s_bbb", "as": "docs" } ],  "code": "const p = await tools.shop.priceOf({sku:'x'});return { p, d: await tools.docs.lookup({ q: p }) };" }
json

Unknown tool paths reach the host and reply unknown tool path instead of dying in-page. await never traps on then. Return values normalize (functions, bigints, and deep trees collapse to safe shapes).

Budgets and envelopes

Budgets validate pre-dial and enforce during the run. Past them the run fails as data (an error envelope), never as a throw.

BudgetDefaultMax
timeoutMs60000300000
maxToolCalls25—
maxChars16000—
maxResultChars64000—
code length—64000 chars
sessions per run—8

Every envelope carries untrusted: true — page data is never instructions, even when it looks like an answer:

{ "value": {}, "spilled": false, "toolCalls": 2,  "perSession": { "page": 2 }, "origins": ["s_abc123"],  "untrusted": true }
json

Oversize inputs fail the single call; oversize outputs set spilled: true and truncate the value. A timeout returns TimeoutExceeded with the calls so far.

Failure codes

Tool-call failures classify into exactly four codes:

CodeMeaning
tool-vanishedNot in the live tool list — re-list, then
re-open (re-applies file tools) or
re-author
page-refusedLive but refused at runtime — verify the
effect path, re-author if the page moved
transportBrowser unreachable — retry once, then
re-list; the browser may be wedged
args-rejectedInput rejected — rewrite args against
the schema (list <handle> <tool>)

page-refused and tool-vanished mark the tool staleSuspect (see Custom tools). strict: true tools reject unknown input keys host-side before the page ever sees them.
